ModMetaData.name: 【CA】指令核心 - RuleCore
ModMetaData.author: Cagier.阳
ModMetaData.description:
通用的反应式自动化规则引擎。
用「当〔条件〕满足 → 让〔谁〕去做〔什么〕」的方式，把你的殖民地行为写成可直接分享的规则。 不做规划器——路径怎么走、战斗怎么打，全部交回原版 AI；规则只负责回答「现在该让谁去做哪件事」。 内置游戏内规则编辑器与调试时间线，每一次求值都能回答「为什么没触发」。
A general-purpose reactive automation layer for RimWorld.
Write colony behaviour as shareable rules: when conditions hold, delegate the right pawn to do the right thing. No planner — pathing and combat stay with vanilla AI; rules only answer "who should do what, now". Ships with an in-game rule editor and a debugging timeline that answers "why didn't it fire".
